modmenu.descriptionTranslation.animated-: Replaces the default Minecraft loading screen with the animated Mojang Studios intro from Minecraft Dungeons / Minecraft Live, including the jingle.
config.animated-mojang-logo.title: Animated Mojang Logo
config.animated-mojang-logo.override_col: Use custom colors instead of the default ones.
config.animated-mojang-logo.only_play_on: If enabled, the animation will only play once when the game starts.
config.animated-mojang-logo.hold_seconds: How long the logo remains on screen before fading to the main menu.
